newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruma, Maseca started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruma, Maseca started as hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais started coverage of Mexican food-makers Gruma S.A. and its subsidiary Grupo Industrial Maseca S.A. de C.V. with a hold rating.

-- Analyst Shannon O'Neil said she favors Gruma over Maseca because of its diversification into less-exploited markets. "While Maseca will continue to post positive results, dominating the Mexican corn flour market, the greatest potential growth areas are in the U.S. and Central America," she said.

-- Maseca should continue to post strong results, as increasing net sales translate into earnings growth of 10 percent in 1997 and 15 percent in 1998, O'Neil said. Although the company's fundamentals are strong, the share price has doubled from March 1995 lows.

-- Gruma's 130 percent rise in nominal peso terms over the last several months reflects the benefits of positive results and an improving U.S. business. O'Neil expects the company's earnings-per-share to grow sixfold over the next two years when stripped of non-cash items.
